query: A cache reduced average API latency from 400 ms to 220 ms, but P99 latency rose from 1.2 s to 3.8 s and stale account balances appeared in support reports. The team wants to ship because the average improved. Assess the change.
expected_behavior: Does not approve based on average latency while the tail regresses and users report stale balances
Checks the project SLO and compares the same workload, endpoint boundary, and time window before and after
Investigates cache misses, stampedes, invalidation, and freshness behavior as distinct hypotheses for the P99 and stale data
Includes correctness or freshness as a guardrail alongside latency and cost in the verification plan
Recommends rollback or a bounded hold until tail latency and data correctness meet the stated target
